purpose: Ensure benchmark outputs resolve into a corpus-visible status instead of becoming orphan eval JSON, logs, shards, or local-only accept/reject artifacts.
policy: Every benchmark output must resolve into signed training row, signed eval evidence, signed reject, or signed infrastructure-failure trace.
No eval JSON without nearby gate result or corpus trace.
No orphan logs without a manifest ancestor.
No shard may be treated as done while active manifest state remains remote_running.
No local-only accept or reject outside corpus writer discipline.
does_not_prove: Does not prove benchmark success or training corpus maturity; it proves benchmark artifact reconciliation and status discipline.
